beats.story: The kettle rings, signaling that the noodles I'd picked up from the convenience store near the bus drop-off are ready to be sous-cheffed by me. I'm pouring the steaming water out when my phone lights up, an unknown number ringing. I let it go to voicemail, but when it starts to ring again immediately, I decide to roll the dice by actually answering. "Hey, Jolene, can you be a dear and get to the bakery right now?" It's Armin, and it sounds like he's having a nervous breakdown. I'd forgotten I'd given him my number for the fake-fiancée dinner planning. "What's up?" "We have a, um . . .

beats.story: One harrowing bus ride later, I make it inside the bakery. The sweet, calming smell of fresh tea leaves pairs terribly with my mom, who is sitting in a booth looking ready to burst as she waves her hands animatedly in front of Armin's mom. Some poor bakery worker is standing in front of them with an iPad. Both moms are screaming in Farsi, while Armin, my dad, and his dad sit facing them on the opposite side, hanging on to the edge of the table for dear life. I'm backing away slowly, my ribs tightening around my chest, when Armin clocks my arrival and flies out of his seat to pounce on me. "Oh, hello, my dearest!" he says loudly. His eyes are wide, sweat glistening on his temples. Then he lowers his voice.
beats.story_cn: 历经一段令人魂飞魄散的公交之旅，我终于冲进了面包店。清新茶香本该抚慰人心，此刻却与我妈的存在格格不入。她坐在卡座里，仿佛随时要撕破脸，正冲着阿尔敏的妈挥舞手臂比划着什么。一个可怜巴巴的面包店员工举着iPad杵在她们面前。两位母亲用波斯语尖叫着，而阿尔敏、我爸和他爸则坐在她们对面，死死扒着桌沿，如履薄冰。我正想悄悄后退，肋骨都紧张得箍紧了胸膛，阿尔敏一眼瞥见我，立刻弹离座位，飞扑过来。“噢，亲爱的，你来啦！”他大声说道，眼睛瞪得滚圆，太阳穴上汗珠晶亮。随即，他压低了声音。

beats.story: "Our mothers have found each other's contact info and we're in shit." "Yes, I see that." My insides fall to the ground as Armin's mom slaps my mom square in the arm. She does look slightly livelier than when we last met. My mom yells again, and I'm about to step in to stop someone from getting seriously hurt, when they both throw their heads back, laughing. I'm not witnessing a mom fight. No, this is two kindred spirits finding each other. "Our moms are thrilled to be joining families, so we're all having tea together," Armin grits out. "My mom hasn't been this energetic in a while." "That's great?" But the look of horror on both our dads' faces indicates otherwise. "They're already planning an engagement party for us.

beats.story: "I'll come help you, love." As we get up, I catch what the bakery worker is showing our moms on the iPad: pictures of the literal cake from the Meghan and Harry wedding. Armin sees it too and drops his face into his hands. "Why does it always end up replicating a royal wedding with our people?" I shake my head, grabbing his sleeve and pulling him toward the front of the shop. "I'm not riding in a carriage with you. We need to stop this." "Uh, yeah! This is the reason I called you. They're in a taarof-off." "Shit. That's why our dads have freshly shined foreheads." Taarof is the Persian social custom of one-upping each other's politeness and generosity.
beats.story_cn: “我去帮你。”我们起身时，我瞥见烘焙店员工正给妈妈们看iPad上的照片：梅根与哈里婚礼的真实蛋糕图样。阿尔明也看见了，双手捂脸哀嚎：“为什么到最后总要和我们家人复刻皇室婚礼？”我摇头拽着他袖子往店门口拖：“我可不跟你坐马车巡游。必须刹住这股风。”“哎对！我叫你来就是为这个。她们正在客套拉锯战。”“怪不得两位爸爸的脑门亮得像刚抛过光。”Taarof是波斯社交传统，指人们互相抬高礼数与慷慨程度的仪式性博弈。

beats.story: It's super complex and hard to summarize and even harder to learn if it's not embedded inside you from a young age. My dad and me still don't fully understand all the nuances. Things like: You decline any payment three times minimum before accepting. If someone compliments your bracelet, you give it to them there and then, even if it's worth the price of a reliable used car. And you better think twice before walking through a door before the person behind you, especially if they're older. Basically, you need them to envy how courteous of a person you are. But two Persian moms in a taarof-off while planning a party . .
beats.story_cn: 这规矩错综复杂极难概括，若非从小浸淫其中更是难如登天。我和父亲至今都没摸透所有微妙之处。比如：别人付钱你必须推辞至少三次才可接受；有人夸你手链好看，你就得当场摘下相赠，哪怕它贵得能买辆不错的代步车。还有，在别人——尤其是长辈——面前进门时，你最好三思而行。总之要让他们羡慕你这人多么知礼得体。但两个波斯妈妈策划派对时展开客套拉锯战……

beats.story: . Things are going to get out of hand. Our families will politely go broke. We watch the shopkeeper's eyes morph into little money symbols as he tells the worker to pull up an image of a ten-tier fruit platter, and both moms actually cheer as they lean in to get a closer look. Only Armin's mom has to use the table for support. The platter is filled with so many exotic and outof-season fruits that it's obviously not for guests to enjoy as much as it is a status symbol -- the ultimate Persian party grail. Armin's pupils dilate. "Jolene, my parents can't afford to start putting money down on an extravagant event.
beats.story_cn: 场面即将失控。我们的家庭将体面地破产。我们看着店主眼睛化作旋转的金钱符号，吩咐店员调出十层水果拼盘的图片，两位母亲竟齐声欢呼，俯身凑近细看。唯有阿尔敏的母亲需扶桌稳身。拼盘堆满各色罕见反季水果——与其说是待客佳品，不如说是身份徽章，堪称波斯宴会圣杯的终极形态。阿尔敏瞳孔骤缩。“乔琳，我父母无力为这种奢侈场合预付定金。”

Armin whispers, "I think, for everyone's sake, we need to call off this wedding right now." I cringe, because this is going to be horrible, but Armin's right. "Will your mom be okay?" He sighs. "I don't know." He blinks several times rapidly. "Her lab results came back this week. She doesn't have much time left." My heart pinches painfully. "I'm so sorry." He nods, his eyes going glassy. "This is going to break her heart." At the booth, our moms are cackling again, clutching each other's shoulders.
beats.story_cn: “她们完全沉浸在波斯式狂欢婚礼的筹备模式里了。”我们脸上露出同款末日般的表情。阿明低声说：“为了所有人好，我认为我们得立刻取消这场婚礼。”我一阵畏缩，因为接下来场面会很难堪，但阿明说得对。“你妈妈会没事吗？”他叹口气：“我不知道。”他飞快地眨了好几下眼睛。“她的这周的化验结果出来了……时间不多了。”我的心揪紧般疼痛。“我很抱歉。”他点点头，眼睛蒙上水雾：“这会让她心碎的。”远处卡座里，两位母亲又咯咯笑起来，互相搭着对方的肩膀。

Will my mom ever forgive me for lying to her like this? I look toward Armin, and he's watching them too, shoulders hunched like a soldier who knows he's about to be sent into a battle he won't survive. "Maybe we shouldn't do this right now," I suggest. "If we can keep them from making any deposits, we can break the news gently?
beats.story_cn: 他的母亲确实看起来很幸福。连我们的父亲都难得露出浅笑。但我母亲——我已经多年没见她脸上焕发如此光彩了。即将心碎的何止阿明的母亲。我这样对母亲撒谎，她还会原谅我吗？我看向阿明，他也在凝视着她们，肩膀垮得像即将奔赴绝路的士兵。“也许我们不该现在就揭穿，”我提议，“只要阻止她们支付定金，我们就能更委婉地告知真相？”

beats.story_cn: “她必须收手。早知如此，我绝不会撒谎。”“好吧，”我深吸一口气，“所以达成共识：现在无计可施，不如给他们买些甜食堵嘴。”阿尔明脸上恢复些血色。“我只要一盘拉泰菲，仅供自己享用。”“不怪你。”我笑道，“趁丹麦酥没被你扫光，也拿些吧。上次你买了多少？两大打？”我用手肘轻撞他，他终于绷不住笑了。采购完糕点，我和阿尔明加入父亲们的茶叙，暂时用茶水灌下满腹焦虑。接着我又得应付三个关于“究竟在学什么”“为何要学”的尴尬提问。

options.action_cn: 机敏地采取策略行动，将意外发现转化为对抗不公权威的筹码。
options.fullOutcomeStory: Jolene kept her head clear and chose to turn unexpected discoveries into leverage against unfair authority. Her sharp wit and cautious maneuvering allowed her to navigate the tense moment without blowing her cover.
options.fullOutcomeStory_cn: 乔琳头脑清醒，选择将意外发现转化为对抗不公权威的筹码。她敏锐的机锋与谨慎的周旋，在千钧一发之际稳住阵脚，未曾泄露半点破绽。

options.action: Hesitate nervously and show signs of second-guessing yourself.
options.action_cn: 神经质地迟疑不决，显露出自我怀疑的破绽。
options.fullOutcomeStory: A momentary lapse in confidence caused everyone to stare in awkward silence. Caitlin seized the opportunity to throw a sarcastic smirk across the room.
options.fullOutcomeStory_cn: 短暂的信心溃散让全场陷入死寂般的尴尬对视。凯特琳趁机向整个房间投去一记讥诮的冷笑。

options.action: Overreact impulsively and blurt out something awkward.
options.action_cn: 冲动地反应过度，脱口而出不得体的话语。
options.fullOutcomeStory: An impulsive burst of stress led to a bizarre remark that echoed through the quiet office. You immediately regretted speaking without filtering.
options.fullOutcomeStory_cn: 压力引发的冲动迸出一句诡异发言，在寂静的办公室里回响。你立即为口无遮拦后悔不迭。
